purpose: Release-build expected values for METADATA/ProteinIdentification.h members the class test does not pin: engine-name key order, settings equality, getChargeRange, name tables, primary MS run paths (including the filesystem-aware MSExperiment overload), coverage/modification validation and Release PeptideIndexer output on two runs that differ only in SE: key order.

driver.runs: every case twice, each in a fresh process with a clean environment; records, stderr and exit codes identical (results/differ.txt empty)

records.format: case<TAB>key<TAB>value; run directories are reported as <dir>

peptide_indexer.command: PeptideIndexer -in order_<which>.idXML -fasta order.fasta -out out.idXML -threads 1 -missing_decoy_action warn -unmatched_action warn
peptide_indexer.msgf_first: exit 0; 'Peptide identification engine: MSGFPLUS'; 'Enzyme: Trypsin/P'; PSTEK matched to P1 10-14 (aa_before R), unmatched 0
peptide_indexer.comet_first: exit 0; 'Peptide identification engine: COMET'; 'Enzyme: Trypsin'; PSTEK unmatched, unmatched 1
